```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
```

Exploration of a road type traffic criterion from OpenStreetMap for both cities. Instruction:
`mcda/Traffic_instructions.Rmd`, section 2 (24 November 2026). Rules: `mcda/MCDA_paper_results_spec.md`.
No score file is changed: the priority scores in Step 3f are recomputed in memory only. Background: the CAMS-REG
check (`mcda/traffic_cams_reg_check.Rmd`) found that neither CAMS-REG nor the current OpenTransportMap criterion
ranks the Klagenfurt counting stations correctly.

```{r libs}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("R/theme_lancet.R"))
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

CRS_M   <- 3035
ARCHIVE <- dirname(normalizePath(here::here("data")))
OUT_DIR <- here::here("output/figures_mcda/traffic_road_type")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
MIN_M   <- 10   # a class is present in a cell if at least 10 m of it lie inside the cell

knitting <- function() isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))
ktab <- function(x, caption, digits = 1) {
  x <- x %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(., digits)))
  if (!knitting()) { cat("\n", caption, "\n", sep = ""); print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE); return(invisible(x)) }
  x %>% kable(caption = caption) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
top_q <- function(p) { q <- rep(NA_integer_, length(p)); q[!is.na(p)] <- ntile(p[!is.na(p)], 5); q }
lw_pt <- function(pt) pt / (ggplot2::.pt * 0.75)
save_fig <- function(p, name, h, w = 180) invisible(save_figure_lancet(p, name, OUT_DIR, height_mm = h, width_mm = w))
```

# Step 0. Data

```{r step0-files}
osm_files <- c(Malta      = "data/malta/accessibility_malta/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg",
               Klagenfurt = "data/klagenfurt/accessibility_klagenfurt/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg")
ktab(tibble(city = names(osm_files), file = osm_files,
            stated_download = c("5 November 2026", "11 November 2026"),
            file_modified = format(file.mtime(here::here(osm_files)), "%d %B %Y %H:%M")),
     "0. OSM extracts (the ones used for walking)")
```

```{r step0-grids}
malta <- readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds")) %>% mutate(gid = as.character(gid))
klag  <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds"))
stopifnot(nrow(malta) == 10657, n_distinct(malta$gid) == 10657, nrow(klag) == 12418, n_distinct(klag$ID) == 12418)

grids <- list(
  Malta = malta %>% transmute(cell = gid, elig = !ua_not_eligible, pop = Total_Population, unit = NAME,
                              current = norm_traffic, no2 = no2_avg_21, noise = Lden),
  Klagenfurt = klag %>% transmute(cell = as.character(ID), elig = TRUE, pop = popdense_2020,
                                  current = norm_traffic_cat, no2 = no2_final, pm25 = pm25_final,
                                  air_composite = (norm_no2 + norm_pm25) / 2))
grids <- lapply(grids, st_transform, CRS_M)
# Klagenfurt districts: statistical counting districts (Zaehlsprengel, Statistik Austria, code g_id; no names
# in the file), assigned by cell centroid
zsp <- st_read(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_zsp_aest.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>% select(g_id)
grids$Klagenfurt$unit <- as.character(zsp$g_id[sapply(st_intersects(st_centroid(st_geometry(grids$Klagenfurt)), zsp),
                                                       function(i) if (length(i)) i[1] else NA)])
areas <- list(Malta = st_sf(geometry = readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_union_boundary.rds")), crs = CRS_M),
              Klagenfurt = readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_boundary.rds")) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
                st_union() %>% st_sf(geometry = .))
councils <- st_read(here::here("data/malta/Population_Malta_Districts.geojson"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(CRS_M) %>% group_by(NAME) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop") %>% st_intersection(st_union(areas$Malta))
ktab(tibble(city = names(grids), cells = sapply(grids, nrow), eligible = sapply(grids, function(g) sum(g$elig)),
            population = sapply(grids, function(g) sum(g$pop, na.rm = TRUE)),
            current_traffic_missing = sapply(grids, function(g) sum(is.na(g$current)))),
     "0. Grids (Malta airport and port cells not eligible, spec 1.3)", 0)
```

```{r step0-roads}
CLASSES <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "unclassified", "residential", "living_street")
read_roads <- function(cn) {
  st_read(here::here(osm_files[[cn]]), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
    mutate(class = sub("_link$", "", highway)) %>% filter(class %in% CLASSES) %>%
    st_intersection(st_union(areas[[cn]])) %>% st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>%
    mutate(class = factor(class, levels = CLASSES), m = as.numeric(st_length(.)))
}
roads <- lapply(c(Malta = "Malta", Klagenfurt = "Klagenfurt"), read_roads)
# Pieces of road inside each cell
pieces <- lapply(names(roads), function(cn) {
  suppressWarnings(st_intersection(roads[[cn]] %>% select(osm_id, class, name), grids[[cn]] %>% select(cell))) %>%
    st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>% mutate(m = as.numeric(st_length(.))) %>% st_drop_geometry()
}) %>% setNames(names(roads))
cell_class <- lapply(names(pieces), function(cn) {
  pieces[[cn]] %>% group_by(cell, class) %>% summarise(m = sum(m), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(m >= MIN_M)
}) %>% setNames(names(pieces))
for (cn in names(roads)) {
  g <- grids[[cn]]
  hc <- cell_class[[cn]] %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(highest = CLASSES[min(as.integer(class))])
  grids[[cn]] <- g %>% left_join(hc, by = "cell") %>%
    mutate(highest = factor(coalesce(highest, "no road"), levels = c(CLASSES, "no road")))
}
sapply(roads, nrow)
```

# Step 1. Road inventory

## 1a. Km and cells by class

```{r step1a}
inv <- bind_rows(lapply(names(roads), function(cn) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]); e <- g$elig
  km <- st_drop_geometry(roads[[cn]]) %>% group_by(class) %>% summarise(km = sum(m) / 1000, .groups = "drop")
  cc <- cell_class[[cn]] %>% inner_join(g %>% select(cell, elig, pop), by = "cell") %>% filter(elig) %>%
    group_by(class) %>% summarise(cells = n(), pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(class = factor(CLASSES, levels = CLASSES)) %>% left_join(km, by = "class") %>% left_join(cc, by = "class") %>%
    mutate(across(c(km, cells, pop), ~ coalesce(., 0)), city = cn, .before = 1) %>%
    mutate(km_pct = 100 * km / sum(km), cells_pct_eligible = 100 * cells / sum(e),
           pop_pct = 100 * pop / sum(g$pop[e], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select(city, class, km, km_pct, cells_crossed = cells, cells_pct_eligible, pop_pct)
}))
ktab(inv, "1a. Road inventory by OSM class (links in their parent class; cells crossed = at least 10 m inside)")
ktab(inv %>% filter(class == "unclassified") %>% select(city, km, cells_crossed, cells_pct_eligible),
     "1a. Unclassified roads (local in all candidates)")
```

## 1b. Highest class per cell

```{r step1b}
hi_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  g %>% group_by(highest) %>% summarise(cells = n(), pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(highest, fill = list(cells = 0, pop = 0)) %>%
    mutate(city = cn, cells_pct = 100 * cells / sum(cells), pop_pct = 100 * pop / sum(pop), .before = 1) %>%
    select(city, highest, cells, cells_pct, pop_pct)
}))
ktab(hi_tab, "1b. Highest class present in each eligible cell")
```

## 1c. Figures

```{r step1c-palette}
class_cols <- c(motorway = "#67000d", trunk = "#cb181d", primary = "#f16913", secondary = "#fdae6b",
                tertiary = "#3182bd", unclassified = "#9ecae1", residential = "#969696", living_street = "#d9d9d9",
                `no road` = "white")
ras <- function(g) {
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g))); ox <- median(xy[, 1] %% 100); oy <- median(xy[, 2] %% 100)
  tibble(x = round((xy[, 1] - ox) / 100) * 100 + ox, y = round((xy[, 2] - oy) / 100) * 100 + oy)
}
xy <- lapply(grids, ras)
map_base <- function(cn, bar = TRUE) {
  b <- areas[[cn]]; bb <- st_bbox(b)
  mask <- st_sf(geometry = st_difference(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(st_buffer(b, 2000))), st_union(b)))
  list(geom_sf(data = mask, fill = "white", colour = NA),
       if (cn == "Malta") geom_sf(data = councils, fill = NA, colour = "grey75", linewidth = lw_pt(0.15)),
       geom_sf(data = b, fill = NA, colour = "grey25", linewidth = lw_pt(0.3)),
       if (bar) lancet_scale_bar("bl"),
       coord_sf(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], crs = CRS_M, datum = NA),
       theme_lancet_map(base_size = 8), theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
}
raster_panel <- function(cn, fill, scale, tag, bar = FALSE, elig_only = TRUE) {
  d <- bind_cols(xy[[cn]], st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]])) %>% mutate(f = fill)
  if (elig_only) d <- filter(d, elig)
  ggplot() + geom_raster(data = d, aes(x, y, fill = f)) + scale + map_base(cn, bar) + labs(tag = tag, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r step1c-roads, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
road_map <- function(cn) {
  r <- roads[[cn]] %>% arrange(desc(as.integer(class)))
  ggplot() + geom_sf(data = r, aes(colour = class), linewidth = lw_pt(0.4)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = class_cols, name = "OSM class", drop = FALSE) + map_base(cn) + labs(tag = cn) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
}
f1c_roads <- road_map("Malta") + road_map("Klagenfurt") + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
f1c_roads
save_fig(f1c_roads, "roads_by_class", 110)
```

```{r step1c-bars, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
f1c_bars <- ggplot(inv, aes(class, km, fill = class)) + geom_col() + facet_wrap(~ city, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, guide = "none") + labs(x = NULL, y = "Road length (km)") +
  theme_lancet() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
f1c_bars
save_fig(f1c_bars, "km_by_class", 80)
```

```{r step1c-highest, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
f1c_hi <- raster_panel("Malta", grids$Malta$highest, scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, name = "Highest class in the cell", drop = FALSE), "Malta", TRUE) +
  raster_panel("Klagenfurt", grids$Klagenfurt$highest, scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, name = "Highest class in the cell", drop = FALSE), "Klagenfurt", TRUE) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
f1c_hi
save_fig(f1c_hi, "highest_class_per_cell", 110)
```

## 1d. Longest named roads per class, and known roads

```{r step1d-longest}
longest <- bind_rows(lapply(names(roads), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(roads[[cn]]) %>% filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, class, name) %>% summarise(km = sum(m) / 1000, .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(city, class) %>% slice_max(km, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()))
ktab(longest %>% filter(city == "Malta"), "1d. Malta: 10 longest named roads per class", 2)
ktab(longest %>% filter(city == "Klagenfurt"), "1d. Klagenfurt: 10 longest named roads per class", 2)
```

Known roads. Malta by name (the Regional Road is Triq Reġjonali; Kappara and Marsa junction roads by name
pattern). Klagenfurt by road number from the OSM `ref` tag (Overpass extract of 24 November 2026 cached in the
archive by the CAMS-REG check), plus Villacher Ring and Südring by name.

```{r step1d-known}
known_m <- tibble(road = c("Regional Road (Triq Reġjonali)", "Kappara", "Marsa", "Aldo Moro (Marsa junction)"),
                  pattern = c("re[gġ]jonali", "kappara", "marsa", "aldo moro"))
known_malta <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(known_m)), function(i) st_drop_geometry(roads$Malta) %>%
  filter(grepl(known_m$pattern[i], tolower(name))) %>% group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(km = sum(m) / 1000, names = paste(head(unique(name), 4), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(road = known_m$road[i], .before = 1)))
ktab(known_malta, "1d. Malta known roads: km by OSM class", 2)

ov <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(ARCHIVE, "cams_reg", "klagenfurt_osm_ref_ways.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)$elements
tag <- function(e, k) if (is.null(e$tags[[k]])) NA_character_ else e$tags[[k]]
ref_ways <- st_sf(
  osm_id = sapply(ov, function(e) e$id), ref = sapply(ov, tag, "ref"), name = sapply(ov, tag, "name"),
  highway = sapply(ov, tag, "highway"),
  geometry = st_sfc(lapply(ov, function(e) st_linestring(do.call(rbind, lapply(e$geometry, function(g) c(g$lon, g$lat))))),
                    crs = 4326)) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>% mutate(ref_n = gsub("\\s", "", ref))
REFS <- c("A2", "B70", "B70c", "B70d", "B83", "B91")
known_klag <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(lapply(REFS, function(rf) {
    ids <- ref_ways$osm_id[sapply(strsplit(ref_ways$ref_n, ";"), function(r) rf %in% r)]
    st_drop_geometry(roads$Klagenfurt) %>% filter(osm_id %in% as.character(ids) | osm_id %in% ids) %>%
      group_by(class) %>% summarise(km = sum(m) / 1000, .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(road = rf, .before = 1)
  })),
  bind_rows(lapply(c("Villacher Ring", "Südring"), function(nm) st_drop_geometry(roads$Klagenfurt) %>%
    filter(name == nm) %>% group_by(class) %>% summarise(km = sum(m) / 1000, .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(road = nm, .before = 1))))
ktab(known_klag, "1d. Klagenfurt known roads: km by OSM class (our extract, matched by OSM way id or name)", 2)
```

# Step 2. Candidate categorisations

Each cell takes the class of the highest road with at least 10 m inside it; cells with no kept road are in
the lowest class (score 0). Unclassified is local in all candidates.

```{r step2}
cand_map <- tibble(class = c(CLASSES, "no road"),
                   K2 = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                   K3 = c(1, 1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                   K4 = c(1, 1, 0.67, 0.33, 0.33, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                   K5 = c(1, 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0, 0, 0, 0))
ktab(cand_map, "2. Candidate scores by highest class in the cell", 2)
CANDS <- c("K2", "K3", "K4", "K5")
for (cn in names(grids)) {
  grids[[cn]] <- grids[[cn]] %>% left_join(cand_map, by = c("highest" = "class"))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]])[, CANDS]))
}
```

# Step 3. Comparison

## 3a. Class sizes

```{r step3a}
sizes <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(CANDS, function(k) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  g %>% group_by(score = .data[[k]]) %>% summarise(cells = n(), pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(city = cn, candidate = k, cells_pct = 100 * cells / sum(cells), pop_pct = 100 * pop / sum(pop), .before = 1)
})))) %>%
  right_join(bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(CANDS, function(k)
    tibble(city = cn, candidate = k, score = sort(unique(cand_map[[k]]))))))), by = c("city", "candidate", "score")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(cells, pop, cells_pct, pop_pct), ~ coalesce(., 0)), under_2pct = cells_pct < 2) %>%
  arrange(city, candidate, score) %>% select(city, candidate, score, cells, cells_pct, pop_pct, under_2pct)
ktab(sizes, "3a. Class sizes, eligible cells (flag: under 2% of cells)")
top_share <- sizes %>% group_by(city, candidate) %>% filter(score == max(score)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(city, candidate, top_class_cells_pct = cells_pct) %>%
  bind_rows(bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) { g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
    tibble(city = cn, candidate = "Current", top_class_cells_pct = 100 * mean(g$current == max(g$current)))})))
ktab(top_share %>% arrange(city, candidate), "3a. Share of eligible cells in the top class (Step 3 tie rule target: 20%)")
ggplot(sizes, aes(factor(score), cells_pct, fill = under_2pct)) + geom_col() + facet_grid(city ~ candidate, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey50", `TRUE` = "#d73027"), name = "Under 2% of cells") +
  labs(x = "Class score", y = "% of eligible cells") + theme_lancet() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") -> f3a
f3a
save_fig(f3a, "class_sizes", 100)
```

## 3b. Agreement with the current criterion

```{r step3b}
agree_cur <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(CANDS, function(k) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  tibble(city = cn, candidate = k, spearman = cor(g$current, g[[k]], method = "spearman"))
}))))
ktab(agree_cur, "3b. Spearman of each candidate with the current traffic criterion (eligible cells)", 3)
xtabs3b <- lapply(names(grids), function(cn) lapply(setNames(CANDS, CANDS), function(k) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  table(current = g$current, new = g[[k]])
})) %>% setNames(names(grids))
for (cn in names(xtabs3b)) for (k in CANDS) {
  print(ktab(as.data.frame.matrix(xtabs3b[[cn]][[k]]) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("current class"),
             paste0("3b. ", cn, ": current class (rows) x ", k, " class (columns), eligible cells"), 0))
}
```

```{r step3b-maps, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sc <- scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Purples", direction = 1, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Traffic score")
maps_cur <- function(cn, bar_first = TRUE) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]])
  ps <- c(list(raster_panel(cn, g$current, sc, paste(cn, "current"), bar_first)),
          lapply(CANDS, function(k) raster_panel(cn, g[[k]], sc, k)))
  wrap_plots(ps, nrow = 1)
}
f3b <- (maps_cur("Malta") / maps_cur("Klagenfurt")) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
f3b
save_fig(f3b, "current_vs_candidates_maps", 130)

diff_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) { g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  d <- g$K3 - g$current
  tibble(city = cn, cells = nrow(g), differ_more_than_one_class = sum(abs(d) > 0.5),
         pct = 100 * mean(abs(d) > 0.5), K3_higher = sum(d > 0.5), K3_lower = sum(d < -0.5)) }))
ktab(diff_tab, "3b. Cells where current and K3 differ by more than one K3 class (|score difference| > 0.5)")
diff_panel <- function(cn) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]); d <- g$K3 - g$current
  f <- factor(case_when(d > 0.5 ~ "K3 higher", d < -0.5 ~ "K3 lower", TRUE ~ "Within one class"),
              levels = c("K3 higher", "K3 lower", "Within one class"))
  raster_panel(cn, f, scale_fill_manual(values = c(`K3 higher` = "#d73027", `K3 lower` = "#4575b4", `Within one class` = "grey90"),
                                        name = "Current vs K3", drop = FALSE), cn, TRUE)
}
f3b_diff <- diff_panel("Malta") + diff_panel("Klagenfurt") + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
f3b_diff
save_fig(f3b_diff, "current_vs_K3_difference", 110)
```

## 3c. Agreement between candidates

```{r step3c, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
cmat <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) {
  g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
  m <- cor(g[, c("current", CANDS)], method = "spearman")
  as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>% setNames(c("a", "b", "rho")) %>% mutate(city = cn)
}))
ktab(cmat %>% filter(a != "current", b != "current") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = b, values_from = rho) %>%
       relocate(city), "3c. Spearman matrix between candidates (eligible cells)", 3)
f3c <- ggplot(cmat, aes(a, b, fill = rho)) + geom_tile() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ city) + scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Spearman") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_lancet()
f3c
save_fig(f3c, "candidates_spearman", 80)
```

## 3d. Overlap with other criteria

```{r step3d, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
others <- list(Malta = c(NO2 = "no2", Noise = "noise"),
               Klagenfurt = c(`Air quality composite` = "air_composite", NO2 = "no2", `PM2.5` = "pm25"))
red <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grids), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(c("current", CANDS), function(k)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(others[[cn]]), function(o) {
    g <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>% filter(elig)
    v <- g[[others[[cn]][[o]]]]; ok <- !is.na(v)
    tibble(city = cn, candidate = k, criterion = o, cells = sum(ok), spearman = cor(g[[k]][ok], v[ok], method = "spearman"))
  }))))))
ktab(red %>% mutate(at_or_above_0.70 = abs(spearman) >= 0.70), "3d. Spearman with the other pollution criteria (eligible cells, raw indicators; composite = mean of the two normalised scores)", 3)
f3d <- ggplot(red, aes(candidate, criterion, fill = spearman)) + geom_tile() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", spearman)), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, scales = "free_y") + scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_lancet()
f3d
save_fig(f3d, "redundancy_heatmap", 70)
```

## 3e. Klagenfurt counting stations

The 22 stations placed in `traffic_cams_reg_check.Rmd` (same placement: intersection of the road, by OSM `ref`,
with the named cross street; T junctions within 15 m). Class = class of the cell that contains the station.

```{r step3e}
stations <- tribble(
  ~ref,  ~station,                 ~jdtv_2019,
  "B70",  "Schachterlweg",          21850,
  "B70",  "Ramsauerstraße",         19574,
  "B70",  "Rosenbergstraße",        19574,
  "B70",  "Enzenbergerstraße",      21531,
  "B70c", "Mießtalerstraße",        20812,
  "B70c", "Lastenstraße",           20812,
  "B70c", "Bahnhofstraße",          15610,
  "B70c", "10. Oktober Straße",     13975,
  "B70c", "Rosentaler Straße",      13944,
  "B70c", "Waidmannsdorfer Straße", 14386,
  "B70c", "Koschatstraße",          18679,
  "B70d", "Ebenthaler Straße",      18250,
  "B70d", "Gerberweg",              19389,
  "B70d", "Kirchengasse",           18018,
  "B70d", "St. Ruprechter Str.",    16940,
  "B70d", "Flatschacher Straße",    17251,
  "B70d", "Rosentaler Straße",      20670,
  "B70d", "Waidmannsdorfer Straße", 13538,
  "B70d", "Siebenhügelstraße",      12165,
  "B70d", "Süduferstraße",          10308,
  "B83",  "Waltendorfer Straße",    17690,
  "B83",  "Deutenhofenstraße",      21018,
  "B83",  "Radetzkystraße",         18398,
  "B83",  "Koschatstraße",          23351,
  "B91",  "Villacher Ring",         25876,
  "B91",  "Maximilianstraße",       27460,
  "B91",  "Hirschenwirtstraße",     25665,
  "B91",  "Südring",                28517)
norm_name <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x); x <- gsub("ß", "ss", x); x <- gsub("str\\.?$", "strasse", x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-zäöü0-9]", "", x); x
}
osm_k <- st_read(here::here(osm_files[["Klagenfurt"]]), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>% mutate(name_n = norm_name(name))
place <- function(rf, station) {
  road <- ref_ways[sapply(strsplit(ref_ways$ref_n, ";"), function(r) rf %in% r), ]
  cross <- osm_k %>% filter(name_n == norm_name(station))
  if (nrow(road) == 0 || nrow(cross) == 0) return(NULL)
  ix <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_union(road), st_union(cross)))
  if (length(ix) == 0 || st_is_empty(ix)) {
    if (as.numeric(st_distance(st_union(road), st_union(cross))) > 15) return(NULL)
    ix <- st_cast(st_nearest_points(st_union(cross), st_union(road)), "POINT")[2]
  }
  st_sf(ref = rf, station = station, geometry = st_centroid(st_union(st_cast(ix, "POINT"))))
}
pts <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), Map(place, stations$ref, stations$station))) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = c("ref", "station"))
cat("Stations placed:", nrow(pts), "\n")
gk <- grids$Klagenfurt
ix <- sapply(st_intersects(pts, gk), function(i) if (length(i)) i[1] else NA)
st_tab <- st_drop_geometry(pts) %>%
  bind_cols(st_drop_geometry(gk)[ix, c("highest", "current", CANDS)]) %>%
  select(ref, station, jdtv_2019, highest_class_in_cell = highest, current, all_of(CANDS))
second <- function(k) sort(unique(cand_map[[k]]), decreasing = TRUE)[2]
st_tab <- st_tab %>% mutate(across(all_of(CANDS), ~ . >= second(cur_column()), .names = "{.col}_top_or_second"))
ktab(st_tab, "3e. Klagenfurt counting stations: class of the station cell under each candidate", 2)
st_sum <- tibble(candidate = CANDS, stations = nrow(st_tab),
                 in_top_or_second = sapply(CANDS, function(k) sum(st_tab[[paste0(k, "_top_or_second")]])),
                 spearman_with_jdtv = sapply(CANDS, function(k) cor(st_tab$jdtv_2019, st_tab[[k]], method = "spearman")))
ktab(st_sum, "3e. Stations in the top or second class", 3)
st_long <- st_tab %>% select(station, ref, all_of(CANDS)) %>% pivot_longer(all_of(CANDS), names_to = "candidate", values_to = "score")
f3e <- ggplot(st_long, aes(candidate, paste(ref, station), fill = score)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Purples", direction = 1, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Class score") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_lancet()
f3e
save_fig(f3e, "stations_classes", 110, 120)
```

## 3f. Effect on the priority score (in memory only)

Citizen weights recovered from the saved scores (regression without intercept on the criterion scores; exact).
Spec 4.2: score = sum(w_i s_i) / sum(w_i) over available criteria, cells scored as in the saved file (the traffic
criterion has no missing values, so the scored set does not change).

```{r step3f}
crit <- list(Malta = c("norm_lst", "norm_imd", "norm_dist_bs", "norm_Lden", "norm_traffic", "norm_no2", "norm_tree",
                       "norm_green_time", "norm_dist_rec", "norm_green_exp"),
             Klagenfurt = c("norm_lst", "norm_dist_bs", "norm_no2", "norm_pm25", "norm_green_time", "norm_traffic_cat",
                            "norm_income_weighted"))
tr_var <- c(Malta = "norm_traffic", Klagenfurt = "norm_traffic_cat")
sc_dat <- list(Malta = st_drop_geometry(malta), Klagenfurt = st_drop_geometry(klag))
get_w <- function(d, v) {
  cc <- d[complete.cases(d[, v]) & !is.na(d$priority_citizen), ]
  f <- lm(reformulate(v, "priority_citizen", intercept = FALSE), data = cc)
  stopifnot(max(abs(residuals(f))) < 1e-8); coef(f)[v]
}
wlc <- function(d, w, keep) {
  S <- as.matrix(d[, names(w)]); A <- !is.na(S); S[!A] <- 0
  out <- as.numeric(S %*% w) / as.numeric(A %*% w); out[!keep] <- NA; out
}
scores <- lapply(names(sc_dat), function(cn) {
  d <- sc_dat[[cn]]; w <- get_w(d, crit[[cn]])
  re <- wlc(d, w, d$scored); stopifnot(max(abs(re - d$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-10)
  out <- tibble(current = d$priority_citizen)
  for (k in CANDS) { d2 <- d; d2[[tr_var[[cn]]]] <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]])[[k]]; out[[k]] <- wlc(d2, w, d$scored) }
  out
}) %>% setNames(names(sc_dat))
ktab(bind_rows(lapply(names(sc_dat), function(cn) tibble(city = cn, criterion = crit[[cn]],
  weight_pct = 100 * get_w(sc_dat[[cn]], crit[[cn]])))), "3f. Citizen weights recovered from the saved scores (%)")

eff <- bind_rows(lapply(names(scores), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(CANDS, function(k) {
  a <- scores[[cn]]$current; b <- scores[[cn]][[k]]; k2 <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
  qa <- top_q(a); qb <- top_q(b)
  tibble(city = cn, candidate = k, scored_cells = sum(k2), spearman = cor(a[k2], b[k2], method = "spearman"),
         top_quintile_overlap_pct = 100 * mean(qb[which(qa == 5)] == 5))
}))))
ktab(eff, "3f. Priority score with each candidate vs the current score", 3)

units_top <- bind_rows(lapply(names(scores), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(c("current", CANDS), function(k) {
  q <- top_q(scores[[cn]][[k]]); u <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]])$unit
  tibble(unit = u, q = q) %>% filter(q == 5, !is.na(unit)) %>% count(unit, name = "top_cells") %>%
    slice_max(top_cells, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(city = cn, version = k, rank = row_number())
}))))
ktab(units_top %>% mutate(lbl = paste0(unit, " (", top_cells, ")")) %>% select(city, version, rank, lbl) %>%
       pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = lbl),
     "3f. Five councils (Malta) or statistical districts (Klagenfurt, Zaehlsprengel code) with most top quintile cells", 0)
```

```{r step3f-maps, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
tq_cols <- c(`Top quintile` = "#d73027", Other = "grey88")
tq_maps <- function(cn) {
  ps <- lapply(c("current", CANDS), function(k) {
    q <- top_q(scores[[cn]][[k]])
    f <- factor(ifelse(!is.na(q) & q == 5, "Top quintile", "Other"), levels = names(tq_cols))
    raster_panel(cn, f, scale_fill_manual(values = tq_cols, name = "Priority", drop = FALSE),
                 if (k == "current") paste(cn, "current") else k, k == "current", elig_only = FALSE)
  })
  wrap_plots(ps, nrow = 1)
}
f3f <- (tq_maps("Malta") / tq_maps("Klagenfurt")) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
f3f
save_fig(f3f, "top_quintile_current_vs_candidates", 130)
```

# Step 4. Decision criteria (not a choice)

```{r step4}
crit1 <- sizes %>% group_by(candidate) %>% summarise(c1_every_class_2pct_both_cities = all(!under_2pct))
crit2 <- st_sum %>% transmute(candidate, c2_stations_top_or_second = paste0(in_top_or_second, " of ", stations))
crit3 <- red %>% filter(candidate %in% CANDS, criterion %in% c("NO2", "Noise")) %>% group_by(candidate) %>%
  summarise(c3_max_abs_spearman_no2_noise = max(abs(spearman)), c3_below_0.70 = all(abs(spearman) < 0.70))
dec <- crit1 %>% left_join(crit2, by = "candidate") %>% left_join(crit3, by = "candidate") %>%
  mutate(classes = c(2, 3, 4, 5), .after = candidate)
ktab(dec, "4. Decision criteria 1 to 3 (criterion 2 also needs the known road tables in 1d)", 3)
```
